brief.angle: a side hustle that paid off
brief.ptype: sharing a personal story or experience

title: Turned a hobby into $20k in extra income after divorce
body: I've been selling my woodworking projects online for 6 months now. After going through a messy divorce, I needed to generate some cash quickly and take care of myself financially. I was able to sell enough pieces to pay off most of the debt from the separation and even put aside some savings. It's given me peace of mind and allowed me to focus on rebuilding my life.

brief.angle: EV versus hybrid for a long commute
brief.voice: a 27-year-old who moved to a new city

title: Frustrated EV owner in new city with 1 hour commute
body: Just moved to a new city for work and I'm still adjusting to my long daily drive. I traded in my gas guzzler for an electric vehicle thinking it would be more eco-friendly, but the range anxiety is killing me. Every day I have to map out charging stations along my route just to make sure I don't get stuck on the side of the road. Anyone else deal with this issue?

title: Finally got my first egg from the girls!
body: I've been raising backyard chickens for a few months now and I'm thrilled to say that one of them laid an egg this morning. It's a small thing, but it feels like a big accomplishment after all the work we put into getting the coop set up and making sure they're happy and healthy. My wife is excited too - she says we'll be eating eggs for breakfast every day now!

title: Need help with bread that just won't rise.
body: I've been baking my own bread for years but recently I've had a batch of wheat flour that refuses to rise. I've checked the temp, yeast is fresh, and tried adjusting the water ratio but nothing seems to work. Does anyone have any ideas what could be causing this? title: Finally set up my new iMac in the city!
body: I've been putting it off for a while but I finally made the switch from Windows to Mac. It's amazing how much more streamlined and intuitive everything feels. I was worried about losing some of my favorite software, but I was able to find decent alternatives. I'm already loving the sleek design and how easily it integrates with my iPhone. My productivity has gone up 10-fold since making the switch!

brief.angle: renting versus buying a first home
brief.voice: a 27-year-old who moved to a new city

title: Rented in a new city for 6 months and I'm glad I did
body: I've been saying to myself that I'll start house hunting soon, but after a month or two of searching online I realized how much more expensive the mortgage payments would be compared to rent. Plus, I haven't even found a place I like yet. I'm still figuring out the area and making sure it's a good fit for me before committing to a 20-year mortgage.
